svg.title: Repuesthogar — Client project · Production
svg.desc: Product catalog and admin panel built and deployed for a retail store in Uruguay. FastAPI + PostgreSQL API, JWT-protected admin, Argon2, login rate limiting, Cloudinary uploads, SEO prerendering.
